card.name: Start of the word contrast
card.fires_on: The first piece of the word "contrast" (contr-), mainly in imaging-agent labels, e.g. "non-contrasted MRI" or "intravenous contrast". Also fires on "iodinated" just before "Contrast".

modes.label: Non-contrasted MRI
modes.description: The "contr" start of "non-contrasted" in gadolinium agent warnings about MRI.
modes.example: not available with non-<<contr>>asted MRI or other modalities.

modes.label: Contrast headings
modes.description: The start of "contrast" in capitalized dosing or administration headings.
modes.example: DOSING RECOMMENDATIONS FOR INTRAVENOUS<< CONTR>>AST ADMINISTRATION

modes.label: Iodinated before Contrast
modes.description: The end of "iodinated" when "Contrast" is expected next.
modes.example: Discontinuation for Iod<<inated>> Contrast Imaging Procedures

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue with "contr" word starts such as contrast and contract.
card.plain: It spots the point where the word "contrast" (as in contrast dye for imaging) is about to be spelled out.
